answer: A farm faking 515 aliases needs 515 separate watch logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The atlas is the wall and the thread is the gate: Coastguard auxiliary tenure with station watch logs is the check: watches kept at one station across many years. A farm of 515 aliases must climb the wall 515 times, the trellis ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
